Follow-up, Jack, 11 November 2026 (same T3 thread): make the homepage far more image-led with deliberate photographic section backgrounds instead of gradients; remove semicolons from the copy where they appear; make motion and scroll animation feel completely smooth and never buggy; vary positioning so content is not always on the left; split sections where it helps and make each section more immersive and less chunky, following the conventions of award-winning service-business sites; diagnose and fix what is missing from the hero. Follow-up, Jack, 11 November 2026 (later) (same thread), answering four decisions: add HQC's Google reviews as proof with a moving carousel below the hero; remove the repeated 'Cleaning Defined by the Outcome' section labels; fix the header so it does not wrap at 1024px; use the photo of Pedro he sent on WhatsApp (10 November 2026, Pedro's chat) for the founder portrait. Follow-up, Jack, 11 November 2026 (after the 2531bf56 preview): fix the service selector section: make its photograph the section background, move the text to the top, and separate the cards in a split grid; improve the selector's UI and usability. Follow-up, Jack, 11 November 2026: use the logo asset set prepared for Pedro (flat gold logo kit built 28 Oct 2026 to Pedro's 8 Oct 2026 specification: horizontal recomposition for the header, compact monogram, stacked lock-up, favicons and app icons) properly across the site.

requirements.text: Planning: freeze this scope on the nov10-logo-clarity line; earlier accepted Phase 8 requirements (logo round L1/L2, F1-F3, copy restoration, imagery) stay in force.
Homepage only: significantly improve presentation, layout rhythm and motion design (entrance choreography, scroll-linked motion, interactive states) so the page reads as a guided journey.

Raise conversion potential: clearer CTA hierarchy, persistent access to the existing primary actions, a stronger service-selector interaction and less friction, reusing only existing on-page CTA labels.

Preserve every word of homepage copy (visible text, alt text, aria labels, title and meta), its order, every link destination, data-track attribute, selector routing and conversion event. A mechanical text comparison against the baseline must show no changed, removed or reordered copy.
Honour prefers-reduced-motion, keep all content readable without JavaScript, avoid layout shift and LCP delay, keep keyboard and screen-reader behaviour, and add no new runtime dependencies.
Leave every other page, shared component, form, CRM routing, tracking, schema, redirect, every image and the Phase 8 production hold unchanged.
Record the resulting version in revisions/versions.json (and the review room) before handover; full npm run check:revision passes.

Image-led homepage (Jack, 11 Nov): each major section gets a deliberate photographic treatment (full-bleed bands, split media, image-led cards) using only existing library images under public/images, no image repeated on the page, no decorative gradients, glows or orbs; readability overlays are flat tints.
Copy punctuation (Jack, 11 Nov): homepage list items render without trailing semicolons or full stops; no other copy changes. This is the only authorised exception to D3.

Layout and motion (Jack, 11 Nov): vary alignment and composition across sections (centred, right, split, full-bleed), split sections where it clarifies, diagnose and fix the hero (one decisive image, clear hierarchy, routes in view), and make all motion smooth: no jitter, no late pop-in, no cursor gimmicks; scroll effects run on transform and opacity only.

Google reviews (Jack, 11 Nov, later): a dated snapshot of HQC's public Google Business Profile reviews (4.9 rating, 92 reviews at capture) shown as a moving carousel directly below the hero, plus the rating in the hero trust row. Review text verbatim; reviewers shown by first name and last initial; 4- and 5-star reviews shown; no dates. Pauses on hover and focus, static and scrollable under reduced motion, duplicates hidden from assistive technology.
Remove the five repeated 'Cleaning Defined by the Outcome' kickers above the homepage chapters (Jack, 11 Nov, later); the hero kicker and the chapter heading of the same name remain.
Header (Jack, 11 Nov, later): primary navigation and the Request a Quote button stay on one line from 1024px; no label or link changes.
Founder portrait (Jack, 11 Nov, later): replace the founder portrait image with the photograph Pedro sent on WhatsApp, cropped to portrait; same alt text.

Service selector (Jack, 11 Nov): photograph as the section background with a flat tint, heading and intro at the top, the nine situations in a two-column split grid (Homes: 01 to 05; Workplaces and property: 06 to 09) with the recommendation directly beneath; labels, order, routing, results copy and events unchanged.
Review data correction (found 11 Nov): rating-only Google reviews whose captured text was HQC's reply are removed from the carousel, so every displayed quote is the reviewer's own words.

Logo (Jack, 11 Nov): the flat gold horizontal logo in the site header (the compact monogram where the header is tight), the flat gold stacked lock-up in the footer in place of the 3D plaque, favicons (16/32/48 ICO and PNG), an Apple touch icon and web manifest icons from the same kit, and the organisation schema logo pointing at a raster logo file. Artwork copied unchanged from the kit; alt text and link labels unchanged; the old 3D plaque file is kept, not deleted.
